title: Study Notes on Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd Ed.)
description:
Independent personal study notes accompanying Richard S. Sutton and Andrew G. Barto's Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd ed., MIT Press, 2018, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 2.0).

Covers Chapters 1 through 13 across tabular and approximate solution methods, built with Quarto as HTML, PDF, EPUB 3.3, and an Anki cloze deck. Intended as a personal companion for study and review, not a substitute for the textbook.
notes: Independent companion study notes; license applies solely to original content by the author and does not extend to textbook material from Sutton & Barto (2018).
